card.name: Gaps inside dosing and administration directions
card.fires_on: Short words or word parts inside dosing and administration instructions, such as 'to' after 'according', 'air' after 'connected to an', or the space after 'more than'. It also fires partway through long drug names like norelgestromin or transdermal.

modes.label: Linking words in instructions
modes.description: Small words in the middle of administration directions, just before a table, device or number.

modes.label: Inside drug or dosage-form names
modes.description: Middle pieces of long drug or dosage-form names.
modes.example: The dosing interval for fentanyl trans<<der>>mal system is 72 hours.

modes.label: Before a number of days or months
modes.description: The gap after 'more than' or 'less than' where a time span comes next in missed-dose rules.
modes.example: If a planned dose is missed by less than<< >>3 months, administer LEQVIO
